args.lesson: Read the complete Sherlock settlement verdict. Observed official quotations explicitly allow selected AI auditors and describe selection plus engagement-dependent KYC/NDA requirements; legacy payout documentation names USDC. These facts support stopping our present Sherlock participation without the required access and settlement arrangements. They do not establish that every engagement requires both KYC and NDA, that no wallet exists globally, or that the single RUNNING contest is necessarily legacy. Preserve those uncertainties. Reconsider this channel on a concrete eligible engagement and authorized settlement route; meanwhile improve the existing live tender offer through a bounded deadline export using already verified sources. No security work, funding, buyer demand or revenue was established.

description: Sherlock’s documented selection and settlement prerequisites stop that channel; they do not block improvements to our live procurement offer. Five unclassified feedback sources and unexplained mail skips leave demand unknown. No funding or revenue is verified. Next: make the two verified tender deadlines directly usable by bidders, without another market scan.
